status.headline: Shipping, with an audio fix in flight
status.detail: The second production shipment is with customers. Call audio is the live problem — the maker says a fix is being tested and has promised it immediately after the holidays.

facts.note: Retail, as quoted by the maker in September 2026
~5 MB system update, plus a Google Messages app update
Where the maker repeatedly asks people to send reports

calendar_note: Several promised dates are given against the Jewish holiday calendar. In 2026 Rosh Hashanah fell on Sept 12–13 and Sukkos runs Sept 26 – Oct 4, so "after Sukkos" means roughly the second week of October.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 expected end of summer
in_progress.detail: The post states that MindPhone 2 is expected at the end of the summer and is already at the final samples stage, alongside an enthusiastic reply from a prospective buyer. The first MindPhone is still offered at $199.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 timing and design questions
in_progress.detail: The post repeats that MindPhone 2 is expected at the end of the summer and is already at the final samples stage, and addresses design questions by saying it keeps the same style with a larger screen. The first MindPhone remains available for $199.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 timing and design questions
in_progress.detail: The post repeats that MindPhone 2 is expected at the end of the summer and is already at the final samples stage, and answers questions about the design by saying it keeps the same style with a larger screen. The first MindPhone remains available for $199.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 at final samples stage
in_progress.detail: The maker states that MindPhone 2 is expected at the end of the summer and that the project is already at the final samples stage, described as a fast, full-featured device. The post also notes the first MindPhone is still on sale for $199 while stock lasts.

in_progress.title: Google app work nearly finished
in_progress.detail: The maker says the work involves the official Google app, that each edit is slow and each fix causes another bug, but that it is almost finished.

in_progress.title: New update in preparation
in_progress.detail: The maker announces that a new software update is currently being prepared and invites users to sign up as beta testers via a linked form.

in_progress.title: Google Messages with desktop sync
in_progress.detail: The maker says he has tested Google Messages on the MindPhone with sync to his computer and calls it very useful. He says it is coming to users' MindPhones soon.

in_progress.title: Pending update release
in_progress.detail: The maker says he hopes to push the update out tomorrow. The post does not specify what the update contains.

in_progress.title: Google Messages download option
in_progress.detail: The maker reports running into several problems while adding back the option for Google Messages. He says an update with a new, updated app will be sent out that will allow downloading Google Messages.

in_progress.title: Search feature removed pending update
in_progress.detail: The maker states that the search function has been taken down for the time being and that an update will be made.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 final hardware testing underway
in_progress.detail: The maker says the final production-spec hardware has arrived and hardware and service testing is starting now. Fine-tuning the software is described as the next stage.

in_progress.title: Talk and text plus Waze on Android Auto
in_progress.detail: The maker states that talk and text functionality is certain, and that Waze running in Android Auto will definitely come. One of the items is described as still under internal debate.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 hardware sent back for rework
in_progress.detail: At a community event, activists and rabbis previewed the new MindPhone 2 and praised its design. After testing the first phase of the final hardware the maker was not fully satisfied and sent it back.

in_progress.title: Video playback bug in Google Messages confirmed
in_progress.detail: A video circulating showed a way to view videos on the MindPhone. The maker contacted the person who found it, confirmed the cause is a bug in the recently added Google Messages app, and says a fix to close the hole is intended.

in_progress.title: Google Messages bug fixes underway
in_progress.detail: The maker states work is currently in progress on fixing the video bug, on many small bugs in small apps, and on making maps work (described as not properly arranged on the Android side). A fix for many of the Google Messages problems is promised soon.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 feature set and trial production
in_progress.detail: The maker confirms that MindPhone 2 will include calling, texting, Waze and Android Auto. Trial production is scheduled to begin at the end of next month.
in_progress.eta: trial production starts end of next month

in_progress.title: Waze support to be added despite accuracy issues
in_progress.detail: The maker explains that navigation such as Waze was not part of the original phone plan and was not well tested, and that it is inaccurate and does not work indoors. They state they will still add it because customers want it.

in_progress.title: Continued development work on MindPhone 1
in_progress.detail: The maker says there is still some way to go but progress is being made slowly, and that work is still ongoing even on the MindPhone 1. No specific fixes or release date are named.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 development progress
in_progress.detail: The maker reports major progress on the MindPhone 2 and announces a planned trade-in program covering old MindPhones and broken flip phones such as the VN220, Classic and Kyocera. Full details are said to follow.

in_progress.title: Defective stock returned to factory for repair
in_progress.detail: The maker states the entire stock was sent back to the factory to be repaired. Affected units will be replaced for customers and stores at no cost.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 development progress
in_progress.detail: The maker reports substantial progress on the MindPhone 2 and says there will be a trade-in program for old MindPhones as well as for broken flip phones such as the VN220, Classic, Kyocera and models from local companies. Full details are promised later.

in_progress.title: Daily work on MindPhone 2, RCS working
in_progress.detail: The maker says he is working every day to move the MindPhone 2 forward and reports that RCS messaging is now working, with a screenshot attached.

in_progress.title: Beta units before High Holidays, production after
in_progress.detail: The maker plans to send units to beta testers in time for the High Holidays, with production to follow after the holiday period.
in_progress.eta: Beta testers before the High Holidays; production after Yom Tov

in_progress.title: Android Auto app update planned
in_progress.detail: The maker states the device is Android Auto ready and that an app update enabling it is planned. No specific release date is given beyond "soon".

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 beta tester details coming
in_progress.detail: The maker announces that the MindPhone 1 is sold out and says that details about the MindPhone 2 and its beta tester process will start being published soon. No specific date or feature list is provided.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 development underway
in_progress.detail: The maker states that heavy work is being done on the MindPhone 2 and that he is taking extra time so it is finished before pre-orders and shipping, unlike the first model which he says shipped half-baked. No release date is given.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 1 delisted, notes app criticism noted
in_progress.detail: The maker says the MindPhone 1 has been removed from the website after selling at $199, and that before closing the project he wants to make sure it is fully good for everyone. He acknowledges recent criticism of the notes app and asks users about replacing it.

in_progress.title: Replacement notes app for MindPhone
in_progress.detail: After criticism of the existing notes app, the maker asks about adding Color Notes and states he intends to go with Color Notes, saying he needs to call the other vendor about sign-ins. No timing given.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 development underway
in_progress.detail: The maker says work on the MindPhone 2 is in progress and that he is deliberately taking more time than with the first model so it is complete before pre-orders and shipping. No release date is committed to.

in_progress.title: Update planned for Mind 1 apps
in_progress.detail: The maker states that an update is coming for the Mind 1 covering the call app, pictures/gallery, music and notes. No work in progress is described, only that it is expected soon.

in_progress.title: MindPhone 2 golden sample and trial production
in_progress.detail: The author reports that the golden sample of the MindPhone 2 has arrived and is the first sample unit to work properly out of the box. Trial production has now started to build a small limited batch for testing.

in_progress.title: Reported issue to be checked
in_progress.detail: The maker acknowledges a user-reported issue and says it will be looked at and fixed. No work has started and no timing is given.

in_progress.title: Fix promised for tomorrow morning
in_progress.detail: The maker commits that an issue will be fixed tomorrow morning. The post does not identify which issue.

in_progress.title: Fixes underway for app store issues
in_progress.detail: The maker says work is currently in progress to fix all outstanding issues, including the app store.

in_progress.title: Offline music app coming to Mind 1
in_progress.detail: The maker states that the Musicalet offline music app will become available on the Mind 1, delivered together with an update to the call app. It is announced as coming soon but no work is described as underway.

in_progress.title: Mind 2 Pro first 100 units planned
in_progress.detail: The maker says the plan is to have about 100 units of the Mind 2 Pro ready in roughly two weeks, and that they should work fully out of the box without needing updates. He notes the plan may still change.

in_progress.title: First 100 units awaiting software certification
in_progress.detail: The first 100 phones have arrived and the remaining step is finishing the kosher certification of the software. Once the certifying body approves, beta testers will be notified.
in_progress.eta: Hopefully very soon; no firm date

in_progress.title: Messages from other kosher phones issue
in_progress.detail: The maker confirms the phone uses Google Messages and acknowledges there may be a problem with messages arriving from other kosher phones. He says it needs to be looked into, without committing to work.

in_progress.title: Flip phone in final development stages
in_progress.detail: The maker announces that the MindPhone flip phone is in its final development stages after more than a year of work, and that the first final sample was received the previous week.

in_progress.title: Flip phone in final development stages
in_progress.detail: The maker announces that the MindPhone flip phone is in its final development stages after more than a year of work, and that the first final sample was received the previous week.

in_progress.title: Flip phone in final development stages
in_progress.detail: The maker announces that the MindPhone flip phone is in its final development stages after more than a year of work, and that the first final sample was received the previous week.

in_progress.title: Upcoming phone nearing completion
in_progress.detail: The maker says an upcoming phone is expected to be released later in the year and that it appears close to being finished. He adds that it is a different type of phone and should not hurt the existing Mind Pro.

in_progress.title: Final fixes before beta
in_progress.detail: The maker says he just left the office because remaining items still need fixing. He indicates a beta is expected soon.

in_progress.title: Magnets in phone cases
in_progress.detail: The maker states that the 3D-printed cases will have magnets, and that in the final production run all cases will include them. No timing is given for the production run.

in_progress.title: Visual voicemail blocked by software
in_progress.detail: The maker confirms the device has visual voicemail but the software currently still blocks it. He says a fix is expected soon, without describing work already in progress.

in_progress.title: Beta bug fixes before production
in_progress.detail: The maker says beta work is under way: small issues are being fixed, including the kosher-filter box, as standard cleanup. He states his goal is to enter production on April 1.

in_progress.title: Production ready end of April
in_progress.detail: The maker states that production of the phone will not be ready until the end of April, and that he hopes to speed it up. Pre-orders are offered to supporters at a small discount.

in_progress.title: Trade-in program in development
in_progress.detail: The maker states that work is underway on a trade-in program and posts an image. No completion date is given in the post.

in_progress.title: Trade-in program launch to customers
in_progress.detail: The maker says he wants to open the trade-in program to customers at the beginning of May, and first wants to make sure buyers understand how ordering and refunds will work. The work is accepted but not yet finished.

in_progress.title: Shipping target of early May
in_progress.detail: The maker says he wants to ship the device to customers at the beginning of May and wants buyers to understand the terms, including how refunds will work, at the time of ordering. He also notes that trade-in values vary by model and condition.

in_progress.title: Mind 2 Pro enters production, pre-orders open
in_progress.detail: The maker announces that after more than two years the new Mind 2 Pro is going into production and posts the pre-order link. Everyone who pre-orders is promised a free case valued at $25, with a code sent by email.

in_progress.title: Two additional phone models in development
in_progress.detail: The maker says each phone is designed for different people, and that they are working on two more phones aimed at other markets and potential customers. No schedule is given.

in_progress.title: Google backup and local SMS restore app
in_progress.detail: The maker says both Google backup for the whole phone and a local SMS restore app are involved. No timing or work status is given.

in_progress.title: Feature currently with testers
in_progress.detail: The maker states that the item under discussion is currently being tested by a few testers.

in_progress.title: Google Photos backup app under consideration
in_progress.detail: The maker says the device will apparently include the Google Photos app in the box for backup functions, but adds that this is not fully decided yet.

in_progress.title: Some items still need adjusting
in_progress.detail: The maker acknowledges that there are still things on the phone that need to be adjusted, and tells users not to worry. No specific fix or schedule is committed to.

in_progress.title: Wallpaper pack, then launcher and clocks
in_progress.detail: The maker says a new wallpaper pack is coming. Work on the launcher and clocks will only begin once everything is stable and running smoothly.
in_progress.eta: once everything is stable and smooth

in_progress.title: MMS fix ready, release bundling undecided
in_progress.detail: The maker says an MMS fix already exists but was meant to be released together with fixes for other issues. An update containing only the MMS fix may be sent out instead.

in_progress.title: Current work list for calls and launcher
in_progress.detail: The maker lists items currently being worked on: incoming calls not arriving for some users, making speaker calls louder, finishing software touch-ups, allowing dialing directly from the main page like a flip phone, and adding a simpler launcher layout for users who want a less smart-feeling device.

in_progress.title: Production started, units to ship by air
in_progress.detail: Answering a reader who doubted the late May / early June shipping date since production only just began, the maker confirms the timeline is realistic and says the phones will be flown in by airplane.

in_progress.title: Production started, units to ship by air
in_progress.detail: Answering a reader who doubted the late May / early June shipping date since production only just began, the maker confirms the timeline is realistic and says the phones will be flown in by airplane.

in_progress.title: Flip phone development progressing
in_progress.detail: The maker says the flip phone is the project he has put the most thought into and that work is moving ahead at a strong pace because he wants to release a complete product. He hopes trial production will begin soon.
in_progress.eta: trial production hopefully soon; no firm date given

in_progress.title: New zmanim app planned for Mind 1
in_progress.detail: The maker states that the Mind 1 will receive a new zmanim app, the same one as on the Mind 2. He says it is expected to come after a few more updates.

in_progress.title: New zmanim app planned for Mind 1
in_progress.detail: Responding to a complaint that location search in the weather and zmanim app stopped working, the maker says the Mind 1 will get a new zmanim app, the same one used on the Mind 2. He indicates it will arrive after a few more updates, and begins to address weather separately.

in_progress.title: Flip phone moving toward trial production
in_progress.detail: The maker says the flip phone is the project he has invested the most thought in, that progress is being made in strong steps, and that he hopes trial production will start soon.
in_progress.eta: hopes trial production will begin soon

in_progress.title: Flip phone moving toward trial production
in_progress.detail: The maker says the flip phone is the project he has put the most thought into, that the work is moving ahead in strong steps, and that he hopes trial production will begin soon.
in_progress.eta: hopes trial production will begin soon

in_progress.title: Second production-ready flip phone sample received
in_progress.detail: Writing from China, the maker reports receiving the second ready-for-production sample of the flip phone. If things go as planned, a trial production run will follow with 50 testers, and details of who the testers will be are to be announced later.

in_progress.title: Mind Flip phone availability timing
in_progress.detail: A reminder that the Mind Flip phone is not expected to be available until the end of 2026. No other work details are given.

in_progress.title: Second production-ready flip phone sample received
in_progress.detail: The maker reports receiving the second production-ready sample of the flip phone and says that if things go as planned a trial production run will follow with 50 testers. Details on who the testers will be are to be announced later.

in_progress.title: Factory visit and reported software fixes
in_progress.detail: The maker reports visiting the factory in China over the past few days, going over final details and issues users had reported that need fixing, mainly software. Parts are said to start arriving in the coming days.
in_progress.eta: Parts start arriving in the coming days

in_progress.title: Factory visit and reported software fixes
in_progress.detail: The maker reports visiting the factory in China over the past few days, going over final details and issues users had reported that need fixing, mainly software. Parts are said to start arriving in the coming days.
in_progress.eta: Parts start arriving in the coming days

in_progress.title: Factory visit and reported software fixes
in_progress.detail: The maker reports visiting the factory in China over the past few days, going over final details and issues users had reported that need fixing, mainly software. Parts are said to start arriving in the coming days.
in_progress.eta: Parts start arriving in the coming days

in_progress.title: Case molds being prepared
in_progress.detail: The maker reports that the molds for the phone cases are now being made, and shares links to images or files. Work on this component is in progress.

in_progress.title: Phone case molds being produced
in_progress.detail: The molds for the phone cases are being prepared, with photos linked. The maker adds that he is waiting for parts to arrive.

in_progress.title: Computer file transfer issue acknowledged
in_progress.detail: The maker acknowledges that transferring files to/from a computer needs a fix and says it will work eventually. No work schedule or timeline is given, and he asks the user for the specific error.

in_progress.title: Assembly scheduled, shipping by air
in_progress.detail: Assembly of the phones is scheduled for June 15, after which the maker says they will be shipped out immediately by air.

in_progress.title: Phone parts arriving for assembly
in_progress.detail: The maker reports that the parts for the phone are coming in so that assembly can be carried out. No completion date is stated in the post.

in_progress.title: Software fixes prepared for upcoming updates
in_progress.detail: The batteries have not yet arrived, so work is currently focused on two things: preparing shipping (labels, etc.) so units can go out as soon as stock lands, and software. A list of items already fixed for the upcoming updates is being shared, starting with voice notes.
in_progress.eta: upcoming updates; batteries not yet arrived

in_progress.title: Software fixes prepared for upcoming updates
in_progress.detail: The batteries have not yet arrived, so work is currently focused on two things: preparing shipping (labels, etc.) so units can go out as soon as stock lands, and software. A list of items already fixed for the upcoming updates is being shared, starting with voice notes.
in_progress.eta: upcoming updates; batteries not yet arrived

in_progress.title: Software fixes prepared for upcoming updates
in_progress.detail: The batteries have not yet arrived, so work is currently focused on two things: preparing shipping (labels, etc.) so units can go out as soon as stock lands, and software. A list of items already fixed for the upcoming updates is being shared, starting with voice notes.
in_progress.eta: upcoming updates; batteries not yet arrived

in_progress.title: Acknowledgement of reported issue
in_progress.detail: The maker replies simply that the issue will be fixed. No work in progress or timing is described.

in_progress.title: Production update and shipping delay
in_progress.detail: The maker shares a production update by video, explaining the reason for the delay and the plan for the coming orders. The written post gives no specific dates.

in_progress.title: Yiddish speech-to-text integration
in_progress.detail: The maker says they are working with Yiddish Labs, the provider used by another service, to bring Yiddish speech-to-text to the new MindPhone. It is intended to be available when the new phone is released.
in_progress.eta: When the new phone comes out

in_progress.title: Production update and shipping delay
in_progress.detail: The maker posts a production update, saying it is a hard one to write, and links a video explaining why production has been delayed and what the plan is for upcoming orders. No specific new date is stated in the text itself.

in_progress.title: GreenTouch 2.0 update being prepared
in_progress.detail: The maker says they are preparing to ship the update moving GreenTouch devices to GreenTouch 2.0. No release date is stated.

in_progress.title: MindPhone in final production assembly
in_progress.detail: The MindPhone is reported to be in its final production assembly phase. If everything goes as planned, units are expected to reach buyers next week.

in_progress.title: Shipping preparation in progress
in_progress.detail: The maker states that shipping is currently in the middle of being prepared and that nothing has been canceled.

in_progress.title: Order shipments being prepared
in_progress.detail: The maker says shipping labels are being prepared right now and the packages are planned to go out next week.

in_progress.title: MindPhone in final production assembly
in_progress.detail: The MindPhone is said to be in the final production assembly phase. If everything goes as planned, units are hoped to reach customers next week.

in_progress.title: First phone shipment arrived, awaiting approval
in_progress.detail: The maker reports the first part of the phone shipment has arrived and he is waiting for certification approval before sending orders out. Orders will be shipped in the order received and pickup is currently unavailable.

in_progress.title: First phone shipment arrived, awaiting approval
in_progress.detail: The maker states the first batch of phones has arrived and he is waiting for the kosher certification body to approve shipping. Orders will go out in the order they were received, and in-person pickup is not available at the moment.

in_progress.title: Kosher certification fix in progress
in_progress.detail: The maker explains that one requirement for the kosher certification was completed but not according to the given protocol, so it must be redone. Once fixed, approval to ship devices to customers can be obtained.

in_progress.title: Shipments received and being distributed
in_progress.detail: The maker states the shipments were received through UPS after DHL returned them, and that they have been distributed. He hopes to have everything by Friday.

in_progress.title: Requested item acknowledged, no timeline
in_progress.detail: The maker says work is being done on the matter and that an announcement will follow once it is ready. No specifics or schedule are given.

in_progress.title: Change deferred to a later update
in_progress.detail: The maker replies that the requested item will come in a later software update. No specifics or timing are given in the post.

in_progress.title: Gboard speech-to-text wrongly blocked
in_progress.detail: The maker confirms that Gboard's speech-to-text was blocked by mistake and needs a fix. No timing for the fix is given.

in_progress.title: Flip phone development in progress
in_progress.detail: The maker says work on the flip phone is underway and that an announcement will come once it is ready. Specification questions from users are left unanswered.

in_progress.title: Fingerprint sensor swap required
in_progress.detail: Short statement that the fingerprint sensor will need to be replaced. No timing or work plan is given.

in_progress.title: AT&T SIM issue to be checked
in_progress.detail: The maker says he will test with an AT&T / US Mobile SIM to see whether there is a problem. If an issue is found, he will try to publish a fix update.
in_progress.eta: tomorrow or Monday, if an issue is found

in_progress.title: Fingerprint sensor change for beta phones
in_progress.detail: The maker has switched to a different fingerprint sensor, so the sensor in existing beta phones no longer works. Beta testers' devices will need the sensor replaced, with no schedule stated.

in_progress.title: Commitment to fix reported issue
in_progress.detail: The maker acknowledges an issue and says it will be fixed. No schedule or work in progress is described.

in_progress.title: Current update close to release
in_progress.detail: The maker states that the current version is nearly ready to go out. No exact release date is given.

in_progress.title: Phones being updated before retailer shipment
in_progress.detail: Retailers do not have phones in stock yet. Work is underway on the clock/update of the phones before they are shipped out.

in_progress.title: Awaiting developer build for testing
in_progress.detail: The maker says he is waiting to receive the update from the developer so he can test it. Work is in progress on the developer side.

in_progress.title: T-Mobile MMS issue workaround
in_progress.detail: The maker acknowledges an MMS problem on T-Mobile and offers a temporary workaround: turn off mobile data so MMS can be enabled. No fix work is committed to in the post.

in_progress.title: Change promised for next update
in_progress.detail: The maker replies that the item under discussion will come in the next update. The post gives no further detail about what is included.

in_progress.title: Suggested feature accepted
in_progress.detail: The maker calls a user suggestion a good idea and says he will see how quickly it can be done after other work is finished. It is explicitly behind existing tasks.
in_progress.eta: after we finish off other things

in_progress.title: Updates with small bug fixes
in_progress.detail: The maker says several updates are planned for this week and that work is underway to include as many fixes for small problems as possible. He adds that forum feedback is read but the app store or chat support is the better place to report issues.

in_progress.title: Microphone problems during calls
in_progress.detail: The maker says he plans to work on the microphone-in-call problems during the coming week. The work is scheduled but has not started.

in_progress.title: Transparent back case in development
in_progress.detail: A user suggested a clear plastic holder so the phone's back and Mind logo would be visible. Ari replied that it is in the making, and that they need to make sure the quality is good and that it does not become discolored.

in_progress.title: Fix planned for coming week
in_progress.detail: The maker says they will work on and fix an unspecified issue during the coming week. No further detail is given about the problem.

in_progress.title: Fix underway for reported issue
in_progress.detail: The maker states that work is underway to fix an unspecified issue as soon as possible.

in_progress.title: Fix in progress for open issue
in_progress.detail: The maker says work on an unspecified issue is still ongoing and expects it to be fixed soon. No specific problem or date is named.

in_progress.title: Speaker and mic work after Rosh Hashanah
in_progress.detail: The maker says work on items such as the speaker and microphone will be handled right after the Rosh Hashanah holiday. It is accepted but scheduled behind the holiday.

in_progress.title: Rollout paused to prepare update
in_progress.detail: The maker says a report came in, so the rollout was paused in order to prepare an update. Work on the update is described as in progress.

in_progress.title: Work in progress on reported issue
in_progress.detail: The maker states he is working on the matter right now. The post does not specify which issue or feature is involved.

in_progress.title: Update in progress for call audio issues
in_progress.detail: A user reports that callers cannot hear him properly after the September 9 software update. The maker says an update is being worked on to fix these small issues.

in_progress.title: Update in progress for call audio issues
in_progress.detail: A user reports poor microphone audio on calls that started after the September 9 software update. The maker states that work is underway on an update to fix these small issues.

in_progress.title: Call audio too quiet for callers
in_progress.detail: A user reports that people can barely hear him on calls unless the phone is close to his mouth, and asks for an update and more testing before releases. The maker's reply is truncated but shows the report was received.

in_progress.title: Reported issue acknowledged for fixing
in_progress.detail: The maker says the problem will be fixed and asks the user to also submit it through the App Store or chat support. No schedule or work in progress is described.

in_progress.title: Call audio too quiet for callers
in_progress.detail: A user reports that people can barely hear him on calls unless the phone is right at his mouth, and asks for an update and better pre-release testing. The maker's reply is cut off mid-sentence but indicates the issue has been seen.

in_progress.title: Call audio — earpiece volume, mic and echo
in_progress.detail: The most-reported problem on the 2 Pro: callers can barely hear the user unless the phone is almost at their mouth. The maker reported progress on speaker, volume and echo on Sept 15 and said it was close to testable, having earlier promised speaker and mic work immediately after Rosh Hashanah.

in_progress.title: Screen flickering
in_progress.detail: Listed by the maker as in progress for an upcoming update.

in_progress.title: MMS over Wi-Fi on smaller carriers
in_progress.detail: Being added for select carriers. The maker notes MMS over Wi-Fi often fails on smaller carriers, and is handling reports from Verizon users directly.

in_progress.title: Volume stepping from silent to sound
in_progress.detail: Reported and confirmed as being worked on alongside the wider audio work.

in_progress.title: Google Messages freezing on the 2 Pro
in_progress.detail: The app could feel stuck and often would not open a chat. The maker said a fix was coming the next morning; worth confirming it landed in the Sept 9 app update.

in_progress.title: Google Maps update
in_progress.detail: A Maps update is queued behind the holidays. A separate Waze fix was pushed on Sept 9 after reports came in.

in_progress.title: Visual voicemail
in_progress.detail: Acknowledged as wanted, but described as very complicated; explicitly deferred.

in_progress.title: Transparent case showing the back
in_progress.detail: Owners asked for a clear case so the phone's back and Mind symbol stay visible, making it read less like a smartphone. The maker says it is being made, pending quality checks.

in_progress.title: Unread-count badge on the wrong side
in_progress.detail: With more than one unread message in a conversation the count is small and sits on the wrong side of the row. Acknowledged, with a request for a screenshot through chat support.

in_progress.title: AI call handling
in_progress.detail: Asked whether Google Voice would be added now that it carries a Lemaaseh approval, the maker said the AI call feature is being looked at.

in_progress.title: Mind Flip Phone
in_progress.detail: A flip-format model is in development. No launch date — the maker says he wants to ship it only once it is good and stable, and is weighing which kosher certification it carries.

in_progress.title: Slow chat support on a dead charger
in_progress.detail: An owner waited days on chat support over a charger that stopped working. The maker asked which channel they had used and suggested a MagSafe charger as a stopgap.

shipped.title: Incremental update released
items: The maker explains that an incremental update has gone out, but users who skipped an earlier update must install a larger update first so that future updates will be smaller.

shipped.title: System update (~5 MB) and Google Messages update
items: Wi-Fi calling: better connectivity and stability for calls over Wi-Fi
Fixed video playback for clips recorded on the phone's own camera
Internal framework updates for the core Google apps
Google Messages updated separately from the Mind app store

shipped.title: Waze fix pushed
items: An update went out for Waze after reports came in, expected to resolve it

shipped.title: System update
items: Resolved the echo on standard phone calls
Applied critical security patches
Rebuilt update delivery so future downloads are smaller and faster

shipped.title: Google Maps pins fixed
items: Map pins corrected, along with other fixes

shipped.title: Messages app update withdrawn
items: The maker explains that an update for the messages app was briefly available on the updater during the first days of shipping and has since been removed. Users who have it can roll back to the previous version through settings.

shipped.title: Pre-order shipments begin
items: The maker announces that shipping of orders to pre-order customers begins today, and thanks customers for waiting.

shipped.title: New Mind 2 system update released
items: A new system update is available for the Mind 2 and is described as a service fix. The maker adds that future updates are planned to move to smaller incremental downloads.

shipped.title: Update contents list
items: A list of what the current update contains: the proximity sensor is fixed, reviews removed from Google Maps, Gemini removed from Google Messages (older phones need a reset), a fix to regain network after losing signal, the power button delay fixed, and double tap to wake. The update is described as already out.

shipped.title: Update released with factory reset advice
items: A software update has just been released to devices. The maker recommends backing up and performing a full factory reset after installing, since some features may not work correctly otherwise.

shipped.title: Update released with factory reset advice
items: A software update has just been released to devices. The maker recommends backing up and performing a full factory reset after installing, since some features may not work correctly otherwise.

shipped.title: Software update released
items: An update has just been released to devices. The maker recommends backing up and performing a full factory reset after installing, because some features may not work correctly otherwise.

shipped.title: New Zmanim app live
items: The new Zmanim (prayer times) app has been released and is now live. The post highlights widgets that show the information on screen so users rarely need to open the app itself.

shipped.title: New Zmanim app live
items: The new Zmanim (prayer times) app has been released and is now live. The post highlights widgets that show the information on screen so users rarely need to open the app itself.

shipped.title: New Zmanim app live
items: The new Zmanim (prayer times) app has been released and is now live. The post highlights widgets that show the information on screen so users rarely need to open the app itself.

shipped.title: MMS and RCS fixes in latest update
items: The latest update fixed MMS and RCS on Verizon and AT&T; on T-Mobile only RCS now works. The maker also notes release notes should be formatted better and that a fix is in progress for the Verizon voicemail issue.

shipped.title: MMS and RCS fixes in latest update
items: The latest update fixed MMS and RCS on Verizon and AT&T; on T-Mobile only RCS now works. The maker also says release notes need to be presented more nicely, and that a fix is being worked on for the Verizon voicemail issue.

shipped.title: Bliss and Fusion added to trade-in program
items: The maker states that the Bliss and Fusion models have been added to the trade-in program. The change is presented as already done.

shipped.title: SMS backup added to Mind 2
items: The maker says he has added SMS Backup to the Mind 2, explaining that users should be able to carry and import their own data.

shipped.title: New MindPhone launch announcement
items: The maker announces the release of the new MindPhone after about two years of work, describing it as a change in how kosher phones are approached. It is presented as now being in users' hands.

shipped.title: System update with security patch
items: The maker announces that a system update containing an important security patch has been pushed out. Users are asked to download and install it.

shipped.title: Waze and Google Maps released on app store
items: Waze and Google Maps are now available on the device's app store. Users are told to install the software update first.

shipped.title: System update preparing Waze and Maps
items: A system update has been sent out to MindPhone devices that prepares them for Waze and Google Maps, with instructions to fetch it via Settings, Advanced, Updater. Waze and Google Maps themselves are said to be going up on the app store the next day.

shipped.title: Google Maps available in beta testing
items: An announcement that Google Maps is now also available for users to test. It was released to testers' devices.

shipped.title: Beta update disables double-tap to wake
items: An update was sent out to beta testers that removes the double-tap-to-wake-screen feature until it is fixed. The same update also makes the device Waze-ready, and users are invited to sign up for the beta via a form.

shipped.title: System update with new launcher released
items: A system update is available for the device via Settings - System - Update, delivering the new app update and adding a long-awaited launcher. Some users report the screen staying black or stuck at the welcome screen after installing.

shipped.title: New shipment received kosher certification
items: The maker reports that the new shipment of devices has now also received its kosher certification, with a photo attached.

shipped.title: Google Messages available in new update
items: An update is available to download through the updater app that makes Google Messages available on the phone. The maker notes the app is resource-heavy and may run slowly for the first few days before speeding up.

shipped.title: Google Messages available in new update
items: An update is available through the updater app bringing Google Messages to the phone. The maker warns the app uses a lot of phone resources and will be slow for the first few days before improving.

shipped.title: Google Messages released to devices
items: The maker announces a new update in the updater app that makes Google Messages available on the phone. It is noted the app is resource-intensive and initially slow.

shipped.title: Google Messages released to devices
items: The maker announces that Google Messages is now available and can be installed via the updater app. Users are told it may run slowly at first and that messages can be synced.

unacknowledged.title: App store downloads stall on Wi-Fi
unacknowledged.detail: A user reports the app store returning "no internet" while connected to Wi-Fi.

unacknowledged.title: Certification mark hard to read on the silver back
unacknowledged.detail: Buyers want the hechsher printed in a colour that stands out, so the phone is recognisable as certified.

steps: Settings → System → System Updater → Check for Update, then Restart Now
After the reboot, open the Mind app store and update Google Messages
A messages update needs the latest system update installed first
how_to_update.stuck: If the download freezes: three-dot menu → Delete Update, restart the phone, then download again. Users who skipped several updates get one large download the first time, and smaller ones after.
